summary: You now see exactly what grants access outside PIM Manager, without the noise of ordinary groups.

new.title: See exactly who has access outside PIM Manager
new.text: Review all delegations shows people, apps and deleted accounts with an Entra or Azure role, role-holding groups and their members, and apps with high-privilege permissions.

fixes.title: Less noise in delegation reviews
fixes.text: Ordinary groups and their members are no longer listed, and the Discovery and gaps report speaks only about PIM groups and PIM admins.

fixes.title: Delegation overview reads less
fixes.text: The delegation overview reads far less, the Azure part once a night, and the page shows when each part was read.

fixes.title: Simpler office account creation
fixes.text: When you create an office account, the steps that do not apply are skipped.
